# Security Policy

## What to report

If you find any, please tell us:

- Any game that loads external code, logs users, or sends data to a location.
- Discriminatory code that might damage visitors or steal data
There are issues with the website and the workflows on GitHub.

## How to report

Please don't open a public issue for security problems.

Use the **Report a vulnerability** button in the Security tab of this repository. If you can't see it, message me on GitHub: [sabirhusseinbalal](https://github.com/sabirhusseinbalal).

I'll respond as soon as I can, and get rid of a bad game in no time.

## Supported versions

Only the most recent version on the `main` branch is supported.
